content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations.
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a coaxial antenna lead-in assembly with a shielded twisted pair routed to antenna dipoles, a protective outer covering, a shield removed section, and a grounded termination connected to a navigation receiver.

Labels, values, units, part numbers, and notes printed in the figure:

- ATTACH TO ANTENNA DIPOLES
- TWISTED SHIELD
- SHIELD REMOVED
- PROTECTIVE OUTER COVERING
- λ/4
- WIRE WRAPPED AND SOLDERED TO SHIELD
- AIRFRAME GROUND
- CENTER CONDUCTOR OPEN
- TO NAVIGATION RECEIVER
